{{Top|leg}}
'''Hangar Bay 4''' was a hangar bay on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], very shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the freighter of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] pirate and trader [[Tuz]] was docked there during his negotiations with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
